subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

After finishing all my pending assignments, I plan to ______ in Goa.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence implies that after completing the pending assignments,** the speaker plans to take a break or enjoy leisure time.**
 
• Option 2, **"take a holiday," fits perfectly in this context **as it aligns with the idea of relaxing or** enjoying time in Goa.**
 
• Other options like** "land a meal," "go bankrupt," or "forgive a debt" **do not make logical sense in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
